name: Kashiro Jasmin
source:
One of the 3 girls in the same class group as Koudai. She has a personality that makes her always want to be the center of attention and decide all rules by herself.

For the group research project during the summer vacation, she proposed to research sex because no one in class has ever before presented it.

[From [url=http://www.complets.co.jp/complets/LRG/lrg_info.html]Official site[/url]]
